layer_3_action.subject: A diverse gathering of Mosasaurs
features: A massive Mosasaurus hoffmannii in the center foreground, mouth slightly open to show 'double' pterygoid teeth.
A smaller, agile Clidastes darting in the upper right.
A Globidens bobbing near the bottom left, eyeing a cluster of ammonites.
All characters feature friendly, glossy eyes and rounded clay proportions.
layer_3_action.action: The Mosasaurs are arranged in a dynamic, 'family portrait' style, swimming toward the viewer as if entering the game arena.

text_overlay.style: Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, mixed case, playful bold sans-serif font.
text_overlay.placement: Center, slightly arched over the main Mosasaurus.

visual_logic.water: Deep slate-blue water with intense, shimmering 'god-rays' creating a spotlight effect on the central characters.
visual_logic.atmosphere: Abundant silver bubbles and floating marine snow to create a sense of depth and 'start-screen' excitement.
